cohort: Seventy Pakistani women diagnosed with peripartum cardiomyopathy were included in the study.
finding: Peripartum cardiomyopathy primarily affected younger women with higher parity and pregnancy-induced hypertension, often presenting in the postpartum period with severe NYHA class III and IV symptoms.
cross-section timing: Diagnosis occurred during the peripartum period, with most cases (78.6%) diagnosed postpartum.
